reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum 30mL
reviews.text: “A good retinol serum for those who already have some tolerance. It has a lightweight, non-greasy texture and absorbs fast. I noticed smoother skin texture after a few weeks. It can feel a bit strong at first, so start slow (2–3 times a week). Works well, just not for complete beginners.”
reviews.zh: 「對已經有少少耐受性嘅人嚟講係一隻唔錯嘅 A 醇精華。質地輕盈唔油笠，吸收得好快。用咗幾星期之後皮膚紋理明顯平滑咗。開頭用會覺得有少少猛，所以要慢慢嚟（一星期 2–3 次）。有效果，不過就唔適合完全嘅初哥。」

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum 30mL
reviews.text: I thought that in my late 30s I should start using retinol and got this. However after a couple of uses o start to notice a little peeling only around the nose and mouth area. It could be that those areas are most sensitive and this may have been too intense but I’ll see how it goes for another few days or so.
reviews.zh: 我諗到我已經三十尾應該開始用 A 醇，所以就買咗佢。但用咗幾次之後，開始發現鼻同嘴附近有少少甩皮。可能係嗰兩個位比較敏感，加埋呢隻可能太猛，但我會再試多幾日睇下點。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum 30mL
reviews.text: Super gentle retinol with other amazing soothing ingredients in it! When I used a prescribed retinoid years ago, it dried out my skin SO badly and I’ve been scared to use any retinol since, but I still wanted the anti-aging and resurfacing benefits of retinol, so I decided to give this one a chance. I use it 1-3 times a week at night, and it doesn’t irritate or dry out my skin at all, and I do believe my skin appears more smooth and my acne scars are reduced. I don’t think it’s a super fast-working formula, so you do need to be consistent in order to see gradual results, but I do prefer how gentle this one is and will continue to use it.
reviews.zh: 好溫和嘅 A 醇，仲加入咗好多勁正嘅舒緩成分！幾年前我用過醫生處方嘅 A 醇類產品，搞到皮膚乾到爆，自此之後我對 A 醇有啲陰影，但我又真係想擁有 A 醇嘅抗老同更新角質功效，所以決定俾呢隻一次機會。我一星期用 1–3 次，喺夜晚用，完全唔刺激又唔會令皮膚乾燥，我真係覺得皮膚望落滑咗，暗瘡印都淡咗。唔算係好快見效嘅配方，所以要持續用先會慢慢見到效果，不過我比較鍾意佢溫和，會繼續用落去。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum 30mL
reviews.text: This serum has made a noticeable difference in the appearance of my fine lines and overall skin texture. After a few weeks of use, my skin looks firmer and more youthful. The retinol works effectively to promote cell turnover and improve skin elasticity. Despite being a potent retinol serum, it is formulated to be gentle on the skin. I experienced minimal irritation and dryness, which is often a concern with retinol products. It also contains soothing ingredients like hyaluronic acid and peptides to help mitigate any potential irritation. The serum has a smooth, lightweight texture that absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a greasy residue. The scent is subtle and pleasant, not overwhelming at all. The 30mL bottle is well-designed with a pump dispenser that ensures precise and hygienic application. The dark bottle also helps protect the retinol from light exposure, maintaining its efficacy.
reviews.zh: 呢隻精華對我嘅細紋同整體膚質都有明顯改善。用咗幾星期之後，皮膚望落緊緻咗、年輕咗。配方入面嘅 A 醇有效促進角質更新同增加皮膚彈性。雖然屬於高效 A 醇精華，但都做到溫和親膚。用完之後刺激同乾燥感都好少，而呢啲正正係 A 醇產品最常見嘅問題。佢仲加入咗透明質酸同胜肽等舒緩成分，等進一步減低刺激。精華質地滑順輕盈，吸收得好快，皮膚完全唔會有油笠感。氣味淡而清香，完全唔會搶。30ml 支裝設計用心，泵裝設計可以準確又衛生咁使用。深色瓶身亦可以保護 A 醇唔好接觸光線，維持成分穩定。

reviews.shade: [New Members Only] SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum 30mL
reviews.text:
Texture and Absorption (5/5):
Upon application, the serum revealed a lightweight and silky texture. It glided smoothly onto my skin, absorbing quickly without leaving any residue. The non-greasy formula was a welcomed feature, making it suitable for both daytime and nighttime use. It provided a velvety finish, setting the stage for subsequent skincare steps.

Compatibility with Other Products (4.5/5):
The Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum seamlessly integrated into my existing skincare regimen. It played well with other products, allowing for layering without causing pilling or interference. Its versatility made it easy to incorporate into both morning and evening routines.

Visible Results (4/5):
Over a few weeks of consistent use, the Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum delivered on its promises. The visible improvement in fine lines, skin texture, and overall radiance spoke to the efficacy of the retinol formulation. It became a staple in my anti-aging skincare routine.
reviews.zh:
質地同吸收（5/5）：
一搽上面就感覺到精華質地輕盈又絲滑。滑順咁推開，吸收得好快，唔會有殘留感。唔油笠嘅配方真係加分，日夜都用得。完埋佢有種絲絨感，剛好可以再疊後續護膚品。

同其他產品嘅相容性（4.5/5）：
Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum 可以順利加入我現有嘅護膚流程。同其他產品夾得好，疊再厚都唔會搓泥或者撞住。佢嘅百搭令我無論日頭定夜晚都好容易加入日常。

明顯效果（4/5）：
持續用咗幾星期，Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum 確實交到貨。細紋、膚質同整體光澤都有可見嘅改善，足以證明呢個 A 醇配方嘅功效。已經成為我抗老護膚流程嘅必備。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum 30mL
reviews.text: My skin is sensitive and prone to breakouts so I am pretty picky with any product. I was interested in trying this product out because I've heard that it's quite gentle for retinol and so far I love it! Definitely would recommend to anyone with sensitive skin who wants to dabble in retinol!
reviews.zh: 我皮膚敏感又容易爆瘡，對任何產品都好揀擇。會想試呢隻係因為聽講佢對 A 醇嚟講已經算好溫和，暫時試咗真係好鍾意！如果敏感肌想開始試吓 A 醇，我一定推薦呢隻！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum 30mL
reviews.text: This retinol serum has a great lightweight, milky consistency and absorbs well. I have not experienced any irritation with this product despite it containing retinol. My skin feels moisturized and my skin texture has improved slightly since adding this to my routine.
reviews.zh: 呢隻 A 醇精華質地輕盈帶奶白色，好易吸收。雖然入面有 A 醇，但我用完完全冇刺激感。皮膚感覺保濕，膚質自從加入呢隻之後都有少少改善。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Reactivating Serum 30mL
reviews.text: Haven't used it yet but the packaging is very bad.. you can barely get the product up and there's also so little product inside the bottle
reviews.zh: 仲未開始用，但包裝好差…個產品好難唧出嚟，而且入面得返好少嘢。
